title: prunus jamasakura subvar. glabra
intro: Prunus jamasakura subvar. glabra, commonly known as naked Korean cherry, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to Korea and Japan, belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, making it useful for treating various conditions like fever, cough, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Prunus jamasakura subvar. glabra include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit analgesic and antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
